summary: Conviction under Section 302 IPC based on testimony of related eyewitnesses; standard of scrutiny for interested witnesses; no premeditation shown; use of blunt axe side and stick suggests sudden fight; Exception IV to Section 300 IPC applicable; conviction reduced to Section 304 Part I IPC; sentence set to period already undergone; release ordered.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.300 Exception IV
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; conviction under Section 302 IPC set aside; substituted with Section 304 Part I IPC; sentence deemed served; appellant to be released if not required in other cases.
